title: Wiki Sprint Sept 2025: Equation of state (EOS) tutorial moved to examples/ sphinx gallery
body:

comments.author: askhl
comments.label_reasoning: The comment raises concerns about the ordering of tutorials in the gallery and the content of README files — both are structural/organizational issues related to how documentation and examples are arranged.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment raises two issues: a question about README recommendations (implying a decision/change is needed) and flags that tutorials appear in the wrong order in the gallery, implying a reordering fix is needed.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: Another issue is that we get `<no title>` on the navigation buttons below (probably applies to all examples)
comments.label_reasoning: The `<no title>` issue on navigation buttons indicates missing or improperly set titles/descriptions in the documentation/examples, which falls under unclear or missing descriptions.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment flags a bug where navigation buttons show '<no title>', implying a fix is needed across all examples.

comments.author: HannaTuerk
comments.body:
Good point @askhl , I opened an issue about the `<no title>`: #1803 

Regarding the README files, I suggest we move all tutorials in a examples/tutorials folder and then we only need one README file. I am looking into the order of the examples, I opened an issue about this one: #1799
comments.label_reasoning: The response proposes reorganizing tutorials into a dedicated examples/tutorials folder to consolidate README files and fix ordering — a structural/organizational improvement to the codebase layout.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment proposes a concrete structural change — moving all tutorials into an examples/tutorials folder with a single README — and references opened issues to track the order and title problems.

thread.actionability_reasoning: Pure acknowledgment and merge announcement with no code change suggested.
